H2927.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to טָלַל; to cover with shade; have a shadow.

H2548.d: from חָמֵץ; seasoned, i.e. salt provender; clean.

H2913.d: from טָחַן; a hand mill; hence (figuratively) chewing; grinding.

H2807.d: from חָשַׁב; estimation; Cashubah, an Israelite; Hashubah.

H2673.d: lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה; a primitive root (compare זֵד)); to cut or split in two; to halve; divide, [idiom] live out half, reach to the midst, participle

H2519.d: by reduplication from חָלַק; properly, something very smooth; i.e. a treacherous spot; figuratively, blandishment; flattery, slippery.

H2646.d: from חָפָה; a canopy; chamber, closet, defence.

H2553.d: from חַמָּה; a sun-pillar; idol, image.

H2998.d: from בָּנָה and יָהּ; building of Jah; Jibnijah, an Israelite; Ibnijah.

H2517.d: from חָלַק; apportioned; Chelkai, an Israelite; Helkai.

H2901.d: a primitive root; to spin; spin.

H2934.d: a primitive root; to hide (by covering over); hide, lay privily, in secret.

H2863.d: from חָתַף; properly, rapine; figuratively, robbery; prey.

H2526.d: the same as חָם; hot (from the tropical habitat); Cham, a son of Noah; also (as a patronymic) his descendants or their country; Ham.

H2746.d: from חָרַר; fever (as hot); extreme burning.

H2808.d: from חָשַׁב; properly, contrivance; by implication, intelligence; account, device, reason.

H2585.d: from חָנַךְ; initiated; Chanok, an antediluvian patriach; Enoch.

H2970.d: or יַאֲזַנְיָהוּ; from אָזַן and יָהּ; heard of Jah; Jaazanjah, the name of four Israelites; Jaazaniah. Compare יְזַנְיָה.

H2917.d: (Aramaic) perhaps, by interchange, for a word corresponding to טִיט; clay; miry.

H2924.d: by variation for טְלָא; a lamb; lamb.

H2758.d: from חָרַשׁ; ploughing or its season; earing (time), ground.

H2749.d: (Aramaic) the same as חַרְטֹם; {a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)}; magician.

H2991.d: from בָּלַע and עַם; devouring people; Jibleam, a place in Palestine; Ibleam.

H2750.d: from חָרָה; a burning (i.e. intense) anger; fierce, [idiom] great, heat.

H2789.d: a collateral form mediating between חֶרֶס and חֶרֶשׁ; a piece of pottery; earth(-en), (pot-) sherd, [phrase] stone.

H2891.d: a primitive root; properly, to be bright; i.e. (by implication); to be pure (physical sound, clear, unadulterated; Levitically, uncontaminated; morally, innocent or holy); be (make, make self, pronounce) clean, cleanse (self), purge, purify(-ier, self).

H2779.d: from חָרַף; properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age; cold, winter (-house), youth.

H2743.d: the same as חֲרוּץ; earnest; Charuts, an Israelite; Haruz.

H2979.d: from the same as אֲתָרִים; stepping; Jeatherai, an Israelite; Jeaterai.

H2821.d: a primitive root; to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken; be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.

H2918.d: feminine of (an equivalent to) טוּר; a wall; hence, a fortress or a hamlet; (goodly) castle, habitation, palace, row.

H2584.d: from חָנַן; favored; Channah, an Israelitess; Hannah.

H2854.d: from חָתַל; a swathing cloth (figuratively); swaddling band.

H2659.d: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as חָפַר through the idea of detection); to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach; be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.

shalt not be put to shame

H2796.d: from חָרַשׁ; a fabricator or any material; artificer, ([phrase]) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, [phrase] mason, skilful, ([phrase]) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.

H2882.d: from טָבַל and יָהּ; Jah has dipped; Tebaljah, an Israelite; Tebaliah.

H2533.d: from חֶמֶד; pleasant; Chemdan, an Idumaean; Hemdan.

H2884.d: plural of טַבַּעַת; rings; Tabbaoth, one of the Nethinim; Tabaoth.

H2869.d: the same as טוֹב; good; fine, good.

H2982.d: from בּוּס; trodden, i.e. threshing-place; Jebus, the original name of Jerusalem; Jebus.

H2734.d: a primitive root (compare חָרַר); to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy; be angry, burn, be displeased, [idiom] earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, [idiom] very, be wroth. See תַּחָרָה.

H2602.d: of uncertain derivation; perhaps the aphis or plantlouse; frost.

H2641.d: from חָסֵר; want; Chasrah, an Israelite; Hasrah.

H2723.d: feminine of חֹרֶב; properly, drought, i.e. (by implication) a desolation; decayed place, desolate (place, -tion), destruction, (laid) waste (place).
r: also out of their desolate places

H2645.d: a primitive root (compare חָפָא, חׇפַף); to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect; ceil, cover, overlay.

H2726.d: or חַרְבוֹנָה; of Persian origin; Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes; Harbona, Harbonah.

H2520.d: a form of חֶלְקָה; smoothness; Chelkath, a place in Palestine; Helkath.

H2932.d: from טָמֵא; religious impurity; filthiness, unclean(-ness).

H2850.d: patronymically from חֵת; a Chittite, or descendant of Cheth; Hittite, Hittities.

H2748.d: from the same as חֶרֶט; a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles); magician.

H2763.d: a primitive root; to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose; make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).
r: only he shall be utterly destroyed

H2839.d: from חָשַׁק; conjoined, i.e. a wheel-spoke or rod connecting the hub with the rim; felloe.

H2963.d: a primitive root; to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels); catch, [idiom] without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, [idiom] surely, tear (in pieces).

H2754.d: or חָרִט; from the same as חֶרֶט; properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket; bag, crisping pin.

H2959.d: a primitive root; to overburden; weary.

H2709.d: from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked; Chakupha, one of the Nethinim; Hakupha.

H2567.d: a denominative from חָמֵשׁ; to tax a fifth; take up the fifth participle

H2686.d: a primitive root (compare חָצָהlemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה); also as denominative from חֵץ; properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks); to shoot an arrow; archer, [idiom] bands, cut off in the midst.

H2761.d: (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of חָרַר; to scorch; singe.

H2937.d: a primitive root; to wander; causatively to lead astray; seduce.
r: because even because they have seduced

H2972.d: patronymically from יָאִיר; a Jairite or descendant of Jair; Jairite.

H2576.d: from the plural of חַמָּה and דּוֹר; hot springs of Dor; Chammath-Dor, a place in Palestine; Hamath-Dor.

H2580.d: from חָנַן; graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty); favour, grace(-ious), pleasant, precious, (well-) favoured.

H2812.d: feminine of חֶשְׁבּוֹן; inventiveness; Chashnah, an Israelite; Hashabnah.

H2545.d: or (shortened) חֲמֹת; feminine of חָם; a mother-in-law; mother in law.

H2727.d: a primitive root; properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed; be afraid.

H2883.d: a primitive root; to sink; drown, fasten, settle, sink.

H2968.d: a primitive root; to desire; long.

H2557.d: xlit châmêtz corrected to châmêts; from חָמֵץ; ferment, (figuratively) extortion; leaven, leavened (bread).

H2943.d: a primitive root; to load a beast; lade.

H2823.d: from חָשַׁךְ; dark (figuratively, i.e. obscure); meaning

H2829.d: the same as חַשְׁמַן; opulent; Cheshmon, a place in Palestine; Heshmon.

H2921.d: a primitive root; properly, to cover with pieces; i.e. (by implication) to spot or variegate (as tapestry); clouted, with divers colours, spotted.

H2696.d: from חָצֵר; court-yard; Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites; Hezron.

H2577.d: patrial from חֲמָת; a Chamathite or native of Chamath; Hamathite.

H2985.d: from בִּין; intelligent; Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings; Jabin.

H2964.d: from טָרַף; something torn, i.e. a fragment, e.g. a fresh leaf, prey, food; leaf, meat, prey, spoil.

H2894.d: a primitive root; to sweep away; sweep.

H2609.d: of Egyptian derivation; Chanes, a place in Egypt; Hanes.

H2940.d: from טָעַם; properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate; advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding.

H2505.d: a primitive root; to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate; deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part(-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth(-er).

H2529.d: or (shortened) חֵמָה; from the same root as חוֹמָה; curdled milk or cheese; butter.

H2865.d: a primitive root; properly, to prostrate; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear; abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.

H2586.d: from חָנַן; favored; Chanun, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites; Hanun.

H2707.d: a primitive root; to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench; carved work, portrayed, set a print.

H2957.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to טָרַד; to expel; drive.

H2522.d: a primitive root; to prostrate; by implication, to overthrow, decay; discomfit, waste away, weaken.

H2701.d: from חָצֵר and סוּסָה; village of cavalry; Chatsar-Susah, a place in Palestine; Hazar-susah.

H2635.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of חַסְפַּס; a clod; clay.

H2971.d: from אוֹר; enlightener; Jair, the name of four Israelites; Jair.

H2965.d: from טָרַף; recently torn off, i.e. fresh; pluckt off.

H2714.d: from חָקַר; examination, enumeration, deliberation; finding out, number, (un-) search(-able, -ed, out, -ing).

H2537.d: or חֲמִיטַל; from חָם and טַל; father-in-law of dew; Chamutal or Chamital, an Israelitess; Hamutal.

H2724.d: feminine of חָרֵב; a desert; dry (ground, land).

H2954.d: a primitive root; properly, apparently to be thick; figuratively, to be stupid; be fat.
